themes.name: Affordable Housing and Tenancy
themes.rule: Proposals that increase affordable housing supply, improve existing homes, or strengthen renter protections belong here.

themes.name: School Learning and Student Support
themes.rule: Proposals that improve school facilities, teaching conditions, class learning, meals, tutoring, or extracurricular education belong here.

themes.name: Public Transit and Cycling
themes.rule: Proposals that improve bus service, transit affordability and information, or cycling infrastructure belong here.

themes.name: Health Care and Aging
themes.rule: Proposals that expand medical, mental-health, preventive, specialist, or in-home care services belong here.

themes.name: Resident Municipal Access
themes.rule: Proposals that make city services, information, online access, or public connectivity easier for residents to use belong here.

themes.name: Neighborhood Safety Measures
themes.rule: Proposals that improve emergency response, policing, surveillance, street lighting, or pedestrian traffic safety belong here.

themes.name: Environmental Sustainability and Waste
themes.rule: Proposals that reduce pollution or waste, expand recycling or composting, improve air monitoring, or support clean energy and urban greening belong here.

themes.name: Parks and Outdoor Recreation
themes.rule: Proposals that create or upgrade parks, community gardens, playgrounds, or dedicated outdoor recreation spaces belong here.

themes.name: Arts, Culture and Libraries
themes.rule: Proposals that expand public arts, performances, museum access, or neighborhood library services belong here.

themes.name: Local Business and Workforce
themes.rule: Proposals that support small businesses, local hiring, workspaces, licensing, or worker reskilling belong here.
